#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Usage: backup.sh SRC_DIR DEST_DIR [KEEP]
# Archive the contents of SRC_DIR to DEST_DIR/backup-<STAMP>.tar.gz and keep
# only the newest KEEP backups (default 5). BACKUP_NOW overrides <STAMP>.
set -eo pipefail

usage() {
  echo "usage: $(basename "$0") SRC_DIR DEST_DIR [KEEP]" >&2
  exit 2
}

[[ $# -ge 2 && $# -le 3 ]] || usage

src=$1
dest=$2
keep=${3:-5}

[[ $keep =~ ^0*[1-9][0-9]*$ ]] || usage

if [[ ! -d $src ]]; then
  echo "error: not a directory: $src" >&2
  exit 1
fi

mkdir -p -- "$dest"
stamp=${BACKUP_NOW:-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)}
archive="$dest/backup-$stamp.tar.gz"

tar -czf "$archive" -C "$src" .

# Stamps sort lexicographically, so newest = greatest name. Only regular files
# matching the backup pattern are candidates for deletion.
find "$dest" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'backup-*.tar.gz' -print |
  LC_ALL=C sort -r |
  tail -n "+$((keep + 1))" |
  while IFS= read -r old; do
    rm -f -- "$old"
  done

echo "$archive"

import os
import re
import subprocess
import tarfile
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "scripts" / "backup.sh"


def run(*args, now=None):
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env.pop("BACKUP_NOW", None)
    if now is not None:
        env["BACKUP_NOW"] = now
    return subprocess.run(
        ["bash", str(SCRIPT), *map(str, args)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        env=env,
    )


@pytest.fixture
def src(tmp_path):
    d = tmp_path / "src"
    (d / "sub").mkdir(parents=True)
    (d / "a.txt").write_text("alpha")
    (d / "sub" / "b.txt").write_text("beta")
    return d


def test_archive_contains_src_contents_relative(src, tmp_path):
    dest = tmp_path / "out"
    result = run(src, dest, now="20260101-120000")
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr

    archive = dest / "backup-20260101-120000.tar.gz"
    with tarfile.open(archive, "r:gz") as tar:
        names = {n.lstrip("./") for n in tar.getnames()}
        assert {"a.txt", "sub", "sub/b.txt"} <= names
        assert not any(n.startswith("/") for n in tar.getnames())
        assert "src" not in names
        assert tar.extractfile("a.txt").read() == b"alpha"


def test_creates_missing_dest_dir(src, tmp_path):
    dest = tmp_path / "nested" / "deeper"
    assert run(src, dest, now="20260101-120000").returncode == 0
    assert (dest / "backup-20260101-120000.tar.gz").is_file()


def test_prints_archive_path(src, tmp_path):
    dest = tmp_path / "out"
    result = run(src, dest, now="20260101-120000")
    assert result.stdout.strip() == str(dest / "backup-20260101-120000.tar.gz")


def test_stamp_defaults_to_local_time_format(src, tmp_path):
    dest = tmp_path / "out"
    result = run(src, dest)
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
    name = Path(result.stdout.strip()).name
    assert re.fullmatch(r"backup-\d{8}-\d{6}\.tar\.gz", name)


def test_default_keeps_newest_five(src, tmp_path):
    dest = tmp_path / "out"
    d

est.mkdir()
    for day in range(1, 8):
        (dest / f"backup-2026010{day}-000000.tar.gz").write_bytes(b"")

    assert run(src, dest, now="20260201-000000").returncode == 0

    kept = sorted(p.name for p in dest.glob("backup-*.tar.gz"))
    assert kept == [
        "backup-20260103-000000.tar.gz",
        "backup-20260104-000000.tar.gz",
        "backup-20260105-000000.tar.gz",
        "backup-20260106-000000.tar.gz",
        "backup-20260201-000000.tar.gz",
    ]


def test_custom_keep(src, tmp_path):
    dest = tmp_path / "out"
    dest.mkdir()
    for day in range(1, 4):
        (dest / f"backup-2026010{day}-000000.tar.gz").write_bytes(b"")

    assert run(src, dest, 2, now="20260201-000000").returncode == 0

    kept = sorted(p.name for p in dest.glob("backup-*.tar.gz"))
    assert kept == ["backup-20260201-000000.tar.gz", "backup-20260103-000000.tar.gz"]


def test_rotation_never_touches_other_files(src, tmp_path):
    dest = tmp_path / "out"
    dest.mkdir()
    others = ["notes.txt", "backup.log", "backup-1.zip", "archive.tar.gz"]
    for name in others:
        (dest / name).write_text("keep me")

    for day in range(1, 4):
        (dest / f"backup-2026010{day}-000000.tar.gz").write_bytes(b"")

    assert run(src, dest, 1, now="20260201-000000").returncode == 0

    assert (dest / "backup-dir.tar.gz").is_dir()
    kept = sorted(p.name for p in dest.glob("backup-*.tar.gz") if p.is_file())
    assert kept == ["backup-20260201-000000.tar.gz"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("keep", ["0", "-1", "abc", "1.5", ""])
def test_invalid_keep_is_usage_error(src, tmp_path, keep):
    dest = tmp_path / "out"

    assert not dest.exists()

def test_too_few_args_is_usage_error(tmp_path, args):

result = run(*args)
